id.description: Unique finding ID: R-{review-dimension}-{sequence}, for example R-security-01.

location.description: In-scope location, such as a file path and line number.

severity.description: Severity value defined by the supplied review policy.

finding.description: Actionable issue and its supporting evidence.

require_action.description: Action needed to address the finding.

confidence_level.description: Confidence in the finding, from 0 to 100.
